Rosa L.: Day 4 check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Rosa L.: What I did: completed local quickstart, opened PR #112 for the feature flag wiring, followed devex docs to run the stack locally.
Rosa L.: Blockers: e2e fails because docker pull from ECR fails with an auth error; VPN also dropped twice during the bootstrap which might've interrupted SSO token.
Rosa L.: Error snippet: ```docker pull 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-inference/runtime:latest
Error response from daemon: Get https://123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/v2/: unauthorized: authentication required
```
Jamal R.: @Alex I. can you advise on ECR + SSO quirks? Rosa, can you paste output of `aws sts get-caller-identity`?
Alex I.: Hi Rosa — for ECR with SSO you usually need to run the SSO login then `aws ecr get-login-password` and pipe to docker login. Example: `aws sso login --profile redwood-dev && aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com`
Alex I.: If you still see InvalidIdentityToken it's likely the SSO session expired or the SSO->IAM role wasn't assumed correctly. Also check `~/.aws/config` profile uses `sso_role_name`.
Rosa L.: I ran the command but got `InvalidIdentityToken` after the pipe. I think the SSO login timed out while VPN bounced.
Devex Bot: Reminder: new-hires checklist item "GitHub org access" is assigned to Sophie (due in 2 days). :clipboard:
Sophie (Eng Mgr): Thanks @Rosa — I'm escalating GitHub/org and SCIM group add to IT now. I can hop on a quick call at 10:30 to walk through AWS SSO and Docker login if that helps.
Alex I.: If you can run `aws sts get-caller-identity --profile redwood-dev` and paste the ARN (or screenshot) that helps. Also run `aws sso login --profile redwood-dev` again and then `aws ecr get-login-password --profile redwood-dev --region us-west-2` to confirm.
Rosa L.: Ran `aws sts get-caller-identity` and it returned `arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/RedwoodDevRole/RosaL` — looks like role assumed but token validity might be short.
Jamal R.: I'll take a quick look at PR #112 this morning and leave comments by noon. :eyes:
Rosa L.: Today: re-run SSO/login with Alex's steps, finish e2e once docker pull succeeds, address Jamal's review, pair with Sophie at 10:30. Thanks everyone — appreciate the help! :pray:
